text:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: high error rate detected for model-serving-prod (/v1/generate). 5xx spike: 18% errors over 5m, p90 latency 4.2s. Pager P1. Link: https://ops.example/incident/3159879999

oncall-alex: Ack — I'm oncall. Pulling up dashboards and log streams.

eng-sre-maya: On standby. Any reported customer impact?

support-lina: We've got 3 open tickets from enterprise customers reporting timeouts and 502s (CUST-123, CUST-998, CUST-42). CS has flagged as sev-high.

runtime-jordan: Preliminary logs show repeated segfaults in model-runner process, stack points to quant_accel.c:447. Also observing GPU OOM events and CUDA OOM logs. Sample tail:
```
[2026-03-17T09:11:02Z] model-runner[pid=4321]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f8a2c8facc in quant_accel.so
[2026-03-17T09:11:02Z] kernel: Out of memory: Killed process 4321 (model-runner) total-vm:12.3G
```

oncall-alex: Is there an immediate safe fallback variant we can route to? If we can steer traffic we should reduce impact while we debug.

eng-sre-maya: Yes — we have a smaller, compatible variant `gpt-serve-lite-v1` that supports same API surface. Recommended temporary split routing and reduce batch sizes.

runtime-jordan: I can push a hotpatch to the model loader to clamp memory allocation and disable prefetch. Planning hotfix `hotfix/loader-clamp-315987`. Will prepare restart script for nodepool-b where failures concentrated.

incidents-bot: Deploy initiated: hotfix/loader-clamp-315987 -> rolling to nodepool-b (6 nodes). CI check passed.

support-lina: Notifying affected customers (CUST-123, CUST-998) that we're mitigating and may route them to fallback. Sending ETA 15m for full mitigation.

product-emi: Please capture which enterprise tenants are impacted so we can coordinate account teams. Also want a brief note for AMs once stable.

oncall-alex: Applying temporary routing rule: steer 30% traffic to gpt-serve-lite-v1, 70% stay on primary. Disabling sticky session to avoid old connections. Command run:
`infra route set --service model-serve --env prod --split 30:70 --variant gpt-serve-lite-v1 --no-sticky`

runtime-jordan: Command completed. Observability: error rate dropped from 18% -> 6% within 3 minutes, p95 latency down to ~1.8s. Still seeing 4 segfaults on nodepool-b during restarts. Capturing cores.

eng-sre-maya: Evicting and cordoning nodepool-b to force restart and rotate instances. Collected core dumps at `/var/crash/core.model-runner.*`. Uploading to S3: s3://redwood-incidents/3159879999/coredumps/

oncall-alex: Core dumps uploaded. Raising RCA runbook. Initial hypothesis: quant kernel regression triggered by a particular sequence length pattern and KV cache combined with prefetch -> memory fragmentation.

support-lina: Escalated to account teams for CUST-123 and CUST-998. PRD updates queued.

product-emi: Thx. Please keep AMs and sales in loop if mitigation extends beyond 30m.

incidents-bot: Incident state: mitigation in progress — routing rule active, hotfix rolling, node rotation underway. Next automated update in 15m or on state change.

oncall-alex: I'll run postmortem template once stabilized. Please add any timeline notes to the incident doc: https://ops.example/incident/3159879999/timeline

eng-sre-maya: Adding notes now. Will follow up with kernel stacktrace and memory histograms.

runtime-jordan: After restart, models on nodepool-b stable for 2m, no new segfaults observed yet. Keeping hotfix until patch PR merged.

oncall-alex: Closing interim update. If errors climb above 5% or a new segfault appears, we re-pager immediately.
